verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs say you can upload a document to its web playground, Forge (/app/playground), and see results instantly before writing code, with no API key required. The changelog also confirms you can preview Track Changes extraction results in the Playground UI. However, the evidence does not explicitly show schema-based structured extraction or drag-and-drop upload in the playground, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit evidence of structured/schema extraction results in Forge, drag-and-drop upload documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground experience

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code

citations.quote: Want to try before writing code? Upload a document to Forge to see results instantly — no API key required.
In-app playground renamed from “Forge Playground” to **Forge** (`/app/playground`).
Track Changes is now available in the Playground — upload a DOCX, PDF, or image file to preview tracked changes extraction results directly in the UI.
